name: Dr. Majid
about: Dr. Abdul Majid Dar is a highly distinguished interventional cardiologist practicing in Jammu and Kashmir. A prestigious Gold Medalist, he completed his MBBS at ASCOMS Jammu, followed by an MD in General Medicine and a DM in Cardiology from the elite Sher-i-Kashmir Institute of Medical Sciences (SKIMS).

name: Dr. Irshad Ahmad Parray.
about: Dr. Irshad Ahmad Parray is a Consultant Gastroenterologist at Ibn Sina Hospital, Budgam, specializing in comprehensive digestive and liver health. He holds an MBBS, MD (Medicine) from SKIMS, and a DNB and DM (Gastroenterology) from GMC Srinagar. Dr. Parray combines advanced diagnostics, including endoscopy and colonoscopy, with a compassionate approach to deliver expert care for a wide range of gastrointestinal and hepatic conditions.

name: Dr. Mohammad Yousuf Dar
about: Dr. Dar is a Consultant General Surgeon with qualifications in MBBS and MS General Surgery. He specializes in laparoscopic gallbladder and appendix surgery, hernia repair, and advanced gastrointestinal procedures. His work often involves emergency trauma care, including complex laparotomies and life-saving interventions for perforations, intestinal obstructions, and massive GI bleeds.

name: Dr. Wasim
about: Dr. Wasim is a Consultant Gastroenterologist and Therapeutic Endoscopist, holding MBBS, MD (Internal Medicine), and DNB (Gastroenterology). He focuses on liver diseases, pancreaticobiliary disorders, gallstones, and pancreatitis. His expertise lies in advanced endoscopic procedures such as ERCP, stenting, and biopsies. He manages critical cases like GI bleeding, acute liver failure, and hepatic encephalopathy.

name: Dr. Mushtaq
about: Dr. Mushtaq is a Consultant Plastic Surgeon with MBBS, MS, and MLC qualifications. He provides both reconstructive and cosmetic surgery services. His practice covers burn management, trauma reconstruction, cleft lip/palate repair, skin grafting, scar revision, and congenital deformity correction. He also performs cosmetic facial and body procedures, including breast reconstruction and body contouring.
